Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the quick responses — the team is excited to see Redwood’s inference pipeline in action. We’re aiming for a 45-minute technical preview with our ML infra and procurement leads. Can you do any time the week of July 9?

One thing: our procurement team has a standard vendor vetting checklist (attached) and they require a completed vendor questionnaire and a signed NDA before any live access or exec walkthroughs. I’ve copied our procurement alias and attached the questionnaire.

Best,

Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the note and for sending the questionnaire.

We can absolutely run a 45-minute live technical preview the week of July 9; I’ll propose slots once Monica confirms availability for the infra deep-dive. Regarding procurement gating: we usually request the minimum here is a signed mutual NDA and a short vendor questionnaire. We can complete the questionnaire on our side, but a couple items (SOC2 report access, data retention requirements for hosted inference) will need your procurement/legal confirmation.

Options:
- If procurement needs the questionnaire completed before the live environment is exposed, we can deliver an async recording of the walkthrough on July 9 and schedule the live session for the week after approval.
- Or, if you sign NDA + share required evidence links (SOC2, HIPAA attestation if applicable), we can hold the live demo on July 10/11.

Monica — can you confirm who from infra should join and whether we need a sandbox token to show private deployment in the demo? Prio: list of items we need to satisfy procurement for live access (I'll summarize below).

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai

Date: 2028-07-01T10:27:00-07:00

Thanks for the context, both. I reviewed the vendor questionnaire — a few clarifying notes from our side that usually speed procurement:

1) NDA: we have a standard mutual NDA (I can send the redlined copy). Procurement needs company legal signoff; turnaround is typically 3–5 business days if nothing material changes.

2) SOC2/HIPAA: we can provide our SOC2 Type II summary report and contact for SOC2 evidence under NDA. If MediQA requires HIPAA-specific attestations, we’ll need to route the HIPAA addendum to Legal — that may add a week.

3) Sandbox/demo access: we do not provide live tenant access before basic vetting is complete. For the preview, we can:
   - provide a pre-recorded demo with masked customer data and a short guided notebook, or
   - provision a time-limited demo token inside a demo environment after NDA is signed and minimum questionnaire fields are answered.

4) Questionnaire items that typically stall procurement: data retention policy, encryption-at-rest KMS details, and subprocessor list. If Alyssa can flag which fields procurement considers "must-have" vs "nice-to-have", we’ll prioritize answers.

Alyssa — happy to jump on a 20-minute call with your procurement lead to walk the checklist and accelerate this.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_Mutual_NDA_v1.pdf (docx)
